tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere outside the video. The off-white of an old print ad, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Image wells before a photo loads, product photo backdrop, pressed state of a full-width row.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, labels, body copy, prices and icons on `paper` and `paper-2` (17:1 on paper). Fill of an open store tile; outline of small buttons.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on `paper` and `paper-2`: descriptions, meta lines, tour/year info (8.8:1 on paper, 7.7:1 on paper-2).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted copy on `paper` only: sold-out prices, placeholders, footer legal (5.1:1 on paper). Never on `paper-2` for text under 24px.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside lists and forms (cart rows, filter sheet). Home has no rules: images sit edge to edge.

tokens.name: film-black
tokens.usage: Top bar and video ground: the only dark surfaces. At 24% it also veils the whole video so the wordmark and icons read over bright footage.

tokens.name: film-white
tokens.usage: Handwritten line, wordmark and icons over `film-black` and over the veiled B&W video (16:1 on film-black).

tokens.name: film-grey
tokens.usage: Placeholder and secondary text on `film-black` only (6.6:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The SOLD OUT word on product tiles, form errors and payment failures; always words, never a colour alone (7.1:1 on paper). Never decoration, never a sale price.

families.display: futura-pt, "Futura PT", Futura, Jost, "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
families.text: futura-pt, "Futura PT", Futura, Jost, "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif
families.kr: "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The ARCHIVIN wordmark only, in the original site's thin, widely tracked caps: centred on the home video in `film-white`; 18px at the left of the scrolled header in `ink`. Never for other words.

styles.name: hello
styles.usage: The handwritten line in the top bar, `film-white` on `film-black`, written on left to right. Only this sentence, lowercase as written.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen: the poster block headline. Uppercase, 2–3 lines, set tight. The only big type on home.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Campaign statements inside a page (lookbook opener, archive page title). Uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Product name on the detail page, page titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Menu drawer items, tab labels, filter titles, primary button labels. Uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase names next to images: lookbook and store captions, product names in grids, section labels (STORES), small button labels, footer links.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 1993년 인 유테로 투어 오리지널. 브록컴 택, 싱글스티치.
styles.usage: Descriptions, product notes, store info. Sentence case.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price on the product detail page and in the bag. Tabular figures; won sign then a space. Grid prices use `meta`.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Size, condition and tour lines; grid prices; store address and hours.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Season and count beside a label (SS26, 4 LOCATIONS), placeholders, legal footer. Uppercase for Latin.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The only gap between images that sit side by side (lookbook 2-up, product grid, store tiles) and between stacked full-bleed images. The paper shows through; no rules.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, price to strike-through.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Side padding of labels above or below an image; gap between stacked meta rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; padding inside tiles and cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the poster block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above the footer and between home sections without a rule.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: images, buttons, tiles, inputs, sheets. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Small tags only (SOLD, 1 OF 1).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The video play control and nothing else.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules inside lists and around inputs, in `rule-soft` or `ink`.

tokens.name: stroke-section
tokens.usage: Outline of small buttons (SHOP POSTERS) and the focus ring. Never a rule between sections or images.
